Elias folded it carefully, lit the lamp, and for the first time understood that some lights guide the keeper home.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台调低音量的机器。高楼的窗大多熄了，只剩零星灯火浮在深色玻璃上。便利店的白光罩住打盹的店员，环卫车缓慢转过空街，水花惊起一只流浪猫。远处的地铁尚未醒来，天桥上却已有赶早班的人，拎着热豆浆，呵出薄雾。天边泛起灰蓝，霓虹逐一退场，城市在寂静里轻轻换气，等待第一声鸟鸣。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It always needs a stopping point, so it does not keep going forever.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding a smaller box inside, until you reach the tiniest box with a prize."}
